verdict.rationale: The evidence shows run transparency, but mostly live rather than after the fact. Operators can watch Sai computers work ('Nothing in the blackbox'), `GET /v1/agents/events` streams progress, and a completed run can be saved as a replayable skill that captures its steps and parameters. Nothing documents a retained run history, recorded screens, or a log of injected inputs that can be reviewed once a run ends. Missing for 10: a persistent post-run audit log or replay, recorded screenshots or video of screens seen, an itemized record of keyboard and mouse inputs injected, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
